method.scope: one existing API + one physical worker, each limited to 2 GiB; same image, sources, fixture workload and test order
method.workflow: one first execution + ten warm samples for each of echo and one SDK config read; sync HTTP caller timings; first execution is on an already-ready worker
method.jobs: one real successful physical runner per registered type per variant; all 23 on attempt 1; public status observed after canonical enqueue and real claim
method.memory: 30-second post-workload host cgroup-v2 trace, final ten seconds; memory.current minus inactive_file; includes entire containers, all processes and kernel charge
method.providers: local deterministic chat/embedding/video fixtures; video preserves OpenRouter hostname and TLS validation; 24-byte signature-valid video fixture, not paid media inference; model catalog refresh makes a real credential-free models.dev request
method.git: real local repositories through the shared fixture mount; container-only git global URL rewrite coexists with per-command credential configuration
method.coverage_limit: one happy path for each type on local execution backend; not all payload/provider variants, production throughput, Kubernetes isolation, restart recovery, cancellation or memory-pressure combinations
method.cpu: active CPU not measured in this follow-up
